en: A black‑and‑white view of a narrow cobblestone street lined with old stone-and-wood houses whose upper stories overhang the lane. A man on horseback rides along the street while a few pedestrians stand or walk nearby. The architecture looks Ottoman/Balkan. At the bottom edge there is a caption in Bulgarian and French identifying the scene as an ancient street in Nessebar.
